title: Peripheral neuropathy
summary: Peripheral neuropathy with disorganization of motor function in two extremities causing extreme limitation in standing/balancing/upper-extremity use, OR marked limitation in physical functioning AND in one of four mental functioning areas (understanding/interacting/concentrating/adapting).

children.criterion: Peripheral neuropathy diagnosis (clinical exam, EMG/NCS, or nerve biopsy)
Paragraph A (motor disorganization) OR Paragraph B (marked limitation + mental area)

Disorganization of motor function in two extremities (see 11.00D1), resulting in an extreme limitation (see 11.00D2) in the ability to stand up from a seated position, balance while standing or walking, or use the upper extremities
Marked limitation (see 11.00G2) in physical functioning (see 11.00G3a), AND in one of four mental functioning areas
Marked limitation in ONE of four mental functioning areas
Marked limitation in understanding, remembering, or applying information (see 11.00G3b(i))
Marked limitation in interacting with others (see 11.00G3b(ii))
Marked limitation in concentrating, persisting, or maintaining pace (see 11.00G3b(iii))
Marked limitation in adapting or managing oneself (see 11.00G3b(iv))
